6:9.text: And had We appointed him an angel, We indeed would have made him a man, and We would have certainly confused them in which they are already confused
(i.e. the Message of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

6:10.text: Messengers before you were mocked at, but their scoffers were surrounded by the very thing that they used to mock at.

6:11.text: : "Travel in the land and see what was the end of those who rejected truth."

6:12.text: : "To whom belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth?" Say: "To Allâh. He has prescribed Mercy for Himself.
Indeed He will gather you together on the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who have lost themselves will not believe
[in Allâh as being the only Ilâh (God), and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as being one of His Messengers, and in Resurrection]

6:13.text: And to Him belongs whatsoever exists in the night and the day, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing."

6:14.text: any other than Allâh, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? And it is He Who feeds but is not fed." Say: "Verily, I am commanded to be the first of those who submit themselves to Allâh
[polytheists, pagans, idolaters and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh]

6:15.text: Say: "I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the torment of a Mighty Day."

6:16.text: has surely been Merciful to him. And that would be the obvious success.

6:17.text: And if Allâh touches you with harm, none can remove it but He, and if He touches you with good, then He is Able to do all things.

6:18.text: above His slaves, and He is the All-Wise, Well-Acquainted with all things.
